# arianet_server_costs (Data Source)

A server's current rate (`GET /cloud/v1/servers/{id}/costs`): one line per billed piece (plan, primary IPv4, floating and elastic IPs, attached volumes, backup add-on), totals per currency, and what its copies cost after a delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_server_costs" "web" {
  server_id = arianet_server.web.id
}

output "web_monthly_cost" {
  value = data.arianet_server_costs.web.totals
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Server to price.

### Read-Only

- `hours_per_month` (Number) Hours monthly prices are quoted over.
- `id` (String) The server ID.
- `kept_backups` (Attributes) The server's backups, billed after a delete only with `keep_backups`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kept_backups))
- `lines` (Attributes List) Billed pieces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lines))
- `snapshots` (Attributes) The server's snapshots, which stay billed after a delete. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))
- `totals` (Attributes List) Sum of the lines per currency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--totals))

<a id="nestedatt--kept_backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kept_backups`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) How many copies.
- `currency` (String) Currency.
- `hourly_price` (Number) Hourly price.
- `monthly_price` (Number) Monthly price.
- `size_gb` (Number) Their total size in GB.


<a id="nestedatt--lines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lines`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency.
- `hourly_price` (Number) Hourly price.
- `id` (Number) ID in its own list (the server's for `server` and `backup`).
- `monthly_price` (Number) Monthly price.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `quantity` (Number) 1, a volume's GB, or the backup's percent of the plan.
- `sku` (String) SKU.
- `type` (String) `server`, `primary_ipv4`, `floating_ip`, `elastic_ip`, `volume` or `backup`.
- `unit` (String) Unit.

Read-Only:

- `hourly_price` (Number) Hourly price.
- `monthly_price` (Number) Monthly price.
- `size_gb` (Number) Their total size in GB.
